unproved_128_bit_scalar_boundary.interpretation: LLVM signatures differ on Windows and x86_64 SysV. Physical ABI equality is not inferred from these signatures. Atomic128 by-value calls are explicitly rejected until separate native proof; opaque pointer storage remains supported.

preceding_research.scope: Hand-authored prototypes informed storage/carrier separation; these are not substituted for generated native tests above.
preceding_research.known_aggregate_mismatch: Clang x86_64 passes a record containing atomic int/Bool/pointer via sret/byval while equivalent repr(C) Rust core-atomic fields use two integer registers; selected by-value aggregates are diagnosed.
